description:
I'm Ravindu Pathirana, team leader and data analytics enthusiast. We're building a lunar landing solution with Python, machine learning, GIS terrain analysis, and a 3D Moon view (Node.js + Three.js).

Join to build a standout portfolio project and own a real piece of the work. Beginners welcome!

Looking for: GIS, ML, Three.js/JavaScript, or Node.js skills. Physics is a bonus.

Message me to get started
